# WebMCP Action Receipt Gate MCP

Paid remote MCP for WebMCP action receipt MCP, structured receipts, audit logs, and reviewer-ready evidence.

Website: https://webmcpactionreceipt.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://webmcpactionreceipt.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://webmcpactionreceipt.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/webmcp-action-receipt-gate-mcp

Use case: WebMCP action receipt MCP with structured receipts.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: check_web_action_receipt, issue_action_receipt, explain_action_policy, log_action_attempt, export_action_audit
